content.value: Suppose Alice, with a web-based email account (such as gmail) sends a message to Bob, who (10) accesses his mail from his mail server using POP3. Discuss how the message gets from Alice's host to Bob's host. Be sure to list the series of application layer protocols that are used to move the message between the two hosts.
